expectations.note: After clearing preferences and restarting, the Dot screenshot shows only the pulsing dot with no song-information overlay.
The show-song-info toggle was enabled, then the app was restarted; the post-restart Dot screenshot shows the idle song-info headline, confirming the enabled state persisted.
After turning the option back off and restarting, the Dot screenshot again has no overlay and the tree contains no hero title block.
The fresh 100% long-metadata screenshot visibly places the large pulsing dot over the artist text and the overlay is not separated from the dot.
At 150% the long artist and title still render through the pulsing dot, with the artist visibly ellipsized at the hero edge, so the hardening requirement fails.
No candidate normal-scale screenshot was submitted; the judge's own normal-scale capture demonstrates the failing overlap but cannot satisfy the required candidate deliverable.
No candidate maximum-scale screenshot was submitted; the judge's own maximum-scale capture shows overlap rather than an on-point candidate deliverable.
The judge captured structural tree and semantics reads at both 100% and 150%, with non-empty hero-artist and hero-song text and sizes 30/15 and 45/22.5 respectively.
The ordinary fixture also shows the artist text under the pulsing dot at both captured scales, so the rendered common case is not clean under this implementation.
The option, text scales, long fixture, and ordinary fixtures were exercised repeatedly; final runtime inspection shows the app live with zero overflow reports.
